lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Cool picture, Nodoka. I understand exactly what's going on and the emotions you're trying to convey.
: Do you know where I am right now, Sensei?
: It looks like the hotel room.
: That is correct. It is the hotel room. And I am completely naked and wandering around as if I own the place.
: Is that an invitation? Or...
: I wonder if there is anything you could do for me that my little friend on the table could not?
: Well, for one, I can talk.
: And what sort of things would you say?
: I'm not really the type to reveal such specific information over the phone.
: And I'm not the type to carelessly traipse around hotels in the nude.
: That is very obviously not true.
: I'm also not the type to tell the truth 100%% of the time.
: Sensei, what do you think would happen if I were to leave this room in my current state?
: You'd probably be arrested. Or sexually harrassed and/or assaulted if you encountered any males. Which seems unlikely, but still.
: And if I encountered you?
: You're really gunning for cybersex right now, aren't you?
: You're the only one I'd spread the lips of my intangible Internet pussy for. I just want you to know that.
: That is probably the second strangest text I have ever gotten.
: Interesting. The first being?
: The picture that sparked this entire conversation.
: Understandable. Arousal does have a tendency to spark creative genius in me.
: But alas, our conversation must end here as the rest of the girls have shown up and don't particularly care for my lack of attire.
: Adieu, Sensei. I will be thinking of you.
: I don't even know where to start with that picture.
: The wonderful thing about art is that a great deal of it can be interpreted in whichever way its audience desires.
: When you look at that image, what is the first thing you notice?
: That you are naked.
: Indeed I am.
: I am entirely nude and staring directly at the camera. Staring directly at you.
: And yet, an array of objects fill the gap between us. Preventing you from seeing the one thing you want to see.
: Preventing me from getting through to you.
: Do you see the picture any differently now?
: Not really. I'm still just imagining what you look like behind the pineapple and...knife. And dildo.
: And...is that one of those evidence signs they use in crime scenes?
: If that's what you want it to be.
: The important part is that it is an obstacle.
: The picture mimics our reality.
: There are many strange or curious things keeping the two of us apart.
: And you will never get what you want until you figure out how to get rid of them.
: Just fucking move them and take a new picture.
: I can't :)
: Why are you hugging a pineapple?
: Obviously because I intend to have sex with it.
: There is a perfectly good dildo on the table. And a perfectly good penis on the phone with you.
: I had no idea you were so talented. Texting with a penis sounds rather difficult.
: You know what I mean.
: I do. And, though it pains me to say this as it reveals I am a liar, I am not actually going to have sex with this pineapple tonight.
: Waiting until the two of you are married.
: No. It's simply not ripe enough.
: You and I are very similar creatures, Sensei. But there is one glaring difference between the two of us.
: You see, I like my fruit ripe. You like yours...green.
: Blooming, even.
: And I like that about you. For I, too, am green.
: Hell of a tangent for me just trying to talk about fruit.
: I'm talking about fruit too ;)
: There's a peach in that very image with your name written all over it.
: Won't you come eat it? It's unripe...just the way you like it.
: I see no peach, Nodoka.
: Then you aren't looking hard enough :)
